coveredContracts: Saved credentials are the only automatically projected integration connections; ambient key names remain catalog metadata.
Ambient keys do not make an auto provider available. Explicitly saving a credential makes it available. Removing the last saved choice does not fall back to ambient keys.
Explicit selected environment bindings resolve only names declared by the integration; an unrelated exported name is rejected.
User-written {env:VARIABLE} provider configuration still loads through the actual configuration-file loader.
Explicit provider/model/credential region and account choices continue to resolve native Bedrock and Cloudflare catalog templates.
Ambient parameters do not bypass Azure or Cloudflare forms, activate Vertex or infer a Bedrock region.
Saved Snowflake account/token and OAuth refresh behavior win over ambient tokens.
GitLab, OpenCode, Modal and router provider paths no longer borrow ambient credentials or endpoints for setup/discovery.
SAP explicit destination options and legacy explicit serviceKey choices remain supported; missing explicit auth is rejected without choosing ambient bindings or deployment fields.
Local Ollama, vLLM and LM Studio compatibility suites continue to pass.
environmentUseRetained: User-declared configuration substitutions and deliberately pinned, declared connection bindings.
GitLab OAuth application client configuration, consumed during the user-selected OAuth flow.
Paths to local gcloud configuration files used to offer explicit form choices, not to activate or fill provider settings.
The legacy SAP bridge writes an explicitly configured serviceKey to its SDK process variable; it does not select an ambient key. Concurrent SDK instances still share that existing process variable.

sdkContractReference.evidence: Public declaration of SAPAIProviderSettings.destination and explicit deployment/resource-group options inspected; no package upgrade or source copying.

limits: Core discovery/configuration policy; this change does not sandbox third-party SDKs or change the operating system environment.
Environment-only setups need an explicit saved connection or configuration reference. No installed user files or credential records were rewritten or deleted.
No live cloud inference, paid provider call, browser claim, installed-service restart, push or publication.
No public Protocol/HttpApi schema change; generated Client files were not edited. The model catalog remains exclusively V2.
The earlier Bedrock native environment/default region fallbacks are superseded. Its historical validation artifact remains pinned to its earlier package tree.
